info.title: suno-api
info.description:
Use API to call the music generation service of Suno.ai and easily integrate it into agents like GPTs.

**Multi-account**: every endpoint accepts `account` (body/form/query) or the `x-suno-account` header (account id, label, email or handle) to pick the Suno account. Without it the default account is used. `suno_cookie` still overrides everything.

post.summary: Generate audio based on Prompt.
post.description:
It will automatically fill in the lyrics.

2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.

`wait_audio` can be set to API mode:

• By default, it is set to `false`, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.

• If set to `true`, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents. Uses POST /api/generate/v2-web/ (Sep 2026 web payload). Default model: chirp-hawk (v6). Custom models: `chirp-custom:<id>`.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously. The lyrics depict the sorrow of people after the war.

post.summary: Generate Audio - Custom Mode
post.description:
The custom mode enables users to provide additional details about the music, such as music genre, lyrics, and more.

 2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits. 

 `wait_audio` can be set to API mode:

• By default, it is set to false, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.

• If set to true, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents. Uses POST /api/generate/v2-web/ (Sep 2026 web payload). Default model: chirp-hawk (v6). Custom models: `chirp-custom:<id>`.

post.summary: Run the full upload workflow asynchronously.
post.description: Starts the full Suno upload workflow in the background. This includes the raw upload, waiting for processing, initializing the clip in the account, setting metadata, accepting the inferred description, and optionally moving the clip to a workspace. The API returns immediately with a `work_id` that can be polled later. Failed works expose error.detail.{error_type, category, retryable, copyright}. Copyright rejections (upload_failure_match_*, upload_failure_lyrics_copyright) always contain "copyright" in the message. Completed works expose result.copyright_muted.
